questions.question: What color is a warning sign?

options.text: Yellow with black lettering or symbols
Blue with white lettering or symbols
White with black lettering or symbols
Red with white lettering or symbols

questions.correctAnswerText: Yellow with black lettering or symbols
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They alert drivers about upcoming road conditions.

questions.question: Is the front brake safe to use?

options.text: Only if the rear brake fails
No, it should not be used often

questions.explanation: The front brake is safe when used properly. It provides most of your motorcycle's stopping power—about three-fourths of the total.

questions.question: Is night riding easier or harder than day riding?

options.text: Easier because you can see other vehicle lights better

questions.explanation: Night riding is harder because it is difficult to see. Without natural light and shadows, it is harder to judge distances and see hazards.

questions.question: What type of clothing helps other drivers see you?
questions.explanation: Wear reflective or bright clothing so other drivers can see you easily. This is one of the best ways to stay visible on the road.

questions.question: What is a danger of riding next to parked cars?

options.text: You may not find a parking spot
A driver may pull out into your path without warning
Other drivers may drive slowly looking for parking
The road surface may be uneven

questions.correctAnswerText: A driver may pull out into your path without warning
questions.explanation: Drivers may exit parked spaces suddenly without checking. Car doors may open into your lane, and pedestrians may step out from between cars.

questions.question: Why should you keep distance between you and the vehicle ahead?

options.text: To give yourself time to see and react to dangers
So traffic counters can count you
To encourage other drivers to cut you off

questions.correctAnswerText: To give yourself time to see and react to dangers
questions.explanation: Following distance gives you space to stop or move if the vehicle ahead stops suddenly. It also helps you see hazards on the road, like potholes.

questions.question: If you wait one hour per drink before riding, will alcohol affect you?

options.text: No, your skills will not be affected
No, as long as you ride slowly

questions.explanation: Your body removes about one drink's worth of alcohol per hour. However, alcohol can still build up in your system, affecting your riding ability even if you wait.

questions.question: What brakes do most motorcycles have?
questions.explanation: Most motorcycles have two brakes—one for the front wheel and one for the rear wheel. The front brake provides more stopping power.

questions.question: How many brakes do most motorcycles have?
questions.explanation: Most motorcycles have two brakes—one for the front wheel and one for the rear wheel.

questions.question: Which factor is least important when choosing a motorcycle helmet?

options.text: It meets U.S. Department of Transportation standards
It fits snugly around your head
It has no cracks or loose padding

questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets U.S. DOT standards, fits snugly all the way around your head, and has no defects like cracks or loose padding. Appearance is not a safety factor.

questions.question: Before getting on a motorcycle, which of these do you NOT need to check?
questions.explanation: Before riding, check tire tread and air pressure, oil and fluid levels, lights, and signals.

questions.question: When should you do a pre-ride inspection?
questions.explanation: Small problems on a motorcycle are much more serious than on a car. Inspect your motorcycle before every ride to stay safe.

questions.question: If you ride on the right side of your lane while following a car, what happens?

options.text: You are in the best position to be seen.
The driver may not see you unless they check their side mirror.
The driver will know you are there.
You stop other drivers from sharing your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The driver may not see you unless they check their side mirror.
questions.explanation: Ride in the center of the lane behind a car. Drivers check their rearview mirror much more often than their side mirror. This position helps them see you.

questions.question: Before riding an unfamiliar motorcycle, what should you do?

options.text: Ride it like your own bike since all bikes are the same.
Check the controls and gear shift pattern.
Trust the owner that everything works.
Assume you know where all the controls are.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check the controls and gear shift pattern.
questions.explanation: All motorcycles are different. Check the controls and gear pattern before riding. Practice the throttle, clutch, and brakes a few times first.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, when should you wear a jacket?

options.text: Only for rides longer than 30 minutes.

questions.explanation: Always wear a long-sleeved jacket when riding, even in warm weather. It protects you from the sun and dehydration.

questions.question: What happens when you drink alcohol quickly?

options.text: More alcohol builds up in your body.
Your body removes the alcohol faster.
You feel fewer effects from the alcohol.
You are more likely to avoid being pulled over.

questions.correctAnswerText: More alcohol builds up in your body.
questions.explanation: When you drink fast, more alcohol builds up in your body. Never ride after drinking any amount of alcohol.

questions.question: How does a motorcycle's brake light compare to a car's brake lights?
questions.explanation: A motorcycle's brake light is not as noticeable as a car's. Flash your brake light before you slow or stop to help other drivers see you.

questions.question: What is the single most important thing you can do to survive a crash?

options.text: Wear a good helmet that is securely fastened.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wear a good helmet that is securely fastened.
questions.explanation: Wearing a good helmet that is securely fastened is the most effective way to improve your chances of surviving a crash.

questions.question: What is important to remember about motorcycles in traffic?

options.text: They are too small to have blind spots.
Their blind spots are too small to be a problem.
They have blind spots that you must check by turning your head.
They have only one blind spot.

questions.correctAnswerText: They have blind spots that you must check by turning your head.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have blind spots like any other vehicle. Always turn your head to check for traffic before changing lanes.

questions.question: For the best protection, what kind of helmet should you wear?

options.text: One that is well-worn and broken in.

questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets U.S. DOT and state standards. It should fit snugly all the way around with no obvious damage.
